title: Code of Criminal Procedure Balochistan Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Balochistan Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXII OF 2001
CODE
OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the
Code
of Criminal Procedure, 7898
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
6th
October, 2001]
No. Legis.2‑48/Law/80‑IV,
dated 6‑10‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made
by the‑ Governor of Balochistan on 2nd October, 2001 is hereby published
for general information:‑‑
1. Short title, extent
and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Code of Criminal Procedure (Balochistan Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come into force on the 14th day of August, 2001.
(3) It shall extend only to "B" areas of Balochistan.

2. Amendment

3. Amendment of section
128 Act V of 1898.‑‑In the said Code,
in subsection (b) of section 128, for the full‑stop at the end a colon
shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added,
namely:‑‑
"Provided that for dispersing any assembly, firing shall not be
resorted to except under the specific directions of a District Administrative
Officer or Assistant District Administrative Officer."

5. Amendment of section
130 Act V of 1898.‑‑In the said Code,
in section 130, in subsection (1)‑‑
(a) for the words "a police officer of the highest rank not
below an Assistant Superintendent, or Deputy Superintendent of Police" the
words and commas "a District Administrative Officer or Assistant District
Administrative Officer" shall be substituted; and
(b) after the words "or such police officer", the words

Officer" shall be inserted.
